description: Open-web discovery was performed in French, Haitian Creole and English with month/date, regional and sector terms. Searches targeted Jérémie/Grand’Anse, Cap-Haïtien, Ouanaminthe, Cayes and Gonaïves; only Jérémie has opened body evidence. Haitian Times reports other-city events only in a search snippet and tool retrieval was restricted. No systematic local archive/LexisNexis access.
required_followup: Use permitted independent local reports for date, public gathering, site-specific attendance and demand in Cap-Haïtien/Ouanaminthe; do not retry the Haitian Times URL.

description: Jérémie reports conflict between “several hundred” and “thousands”; no numeric count or provenance of estimates. The lower wording exceeds 50 qualitatively, but source lineage/reliability and the relevance of the organizer’s violent rhetoric require independent review.
required_followup: Reviewer should assess source independence, lower crowd description, and whether the actual event remained public protest rather than armed resistance; unknown violence/state response/end date remain open.
